title: SONIC: Supersizing Motion Tracking for Natural Humanoid Whole-Body Control
abstract: arXiv:2511.07820v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite the rise of billion-parameter foundation models trained across thousands of graphical processing units (GPUs), similar scaling gains have not been shown for humanoid control. Current neural controllers for humanoids remain modest in size, target a limited set of behaviors, and are trained on a handful of GPUs. We show that scaling model capacity, data, and compute yields a generalist humanoid controller capable of natural, robust whole-body movements. We position motion tracking as a scalable task for humanoid control, leveraging dense supervision from diverse motion-capture data to acquire human motion priors without manual reward engineering. We build a foundation model for motion tracking by scaling along three axes: network size (1.2M to 42M parameters), dataset volume (100M+ frames from 700 hours of motion capture), and compute (21k GPU hours). translated_title: SONIC：为自然拟人全身控制扩展运动追踪技术
translated_abstract: 尽管数十亿参数的基础模型在数千个图形处理单元（GPU）上训练已成常态，但类似规模的扩展收益尚未在拟人控制领域得到体现。当前用于拟人的神经控制器规模仍然较小，目标行为有限，且仅在少量GPU上训练。我们证明，扩展模型容量、数据和计算量能够产生一个通用的拟人控制器，实现自然、稳健的全身运动。我们将运动追踪定位为拟人控制的可扩展任务，利用来自多样化动作捕捉数据的密集监督来获取人类运动先验，无需手动设计奖励函数。我们通过三个维度扩展构建了一个用于运动追踪的基础模型：网络规模（从120万到4200万参数）、数据集规模（超过1亿帧，来自700小时的动作捕捉数据）和计算量（2.1万GPU小时）。除了展示扩展的益处，我们进一步展示了下游应用的改进。
tldr: 通过大规模扩展模型、数据和计算，构建了一个通用拟人运动追踪基础模型，实现自然稳健的全身控制，无需手动奖励工程。
en_tdlr: By scaling model capacity, data, and compute, we build a generalist humanoid motion-tracking foundation model that enables natural and robust whole-body control without manual reward engineering.
